ratings.comment: So rude. Made a joke about s******
Very mean and insensitive

BEST CLASS (outside of my major) IVE TAKEN. You will leave EVERY lecture having learned something that you can actually use to live a healthier life, and not just nutrition she teaches about a huge range of topics like sleep and exercise too. I didn't even take notes her lectures are so engaging you just remember everything. So sad she's leaving UW
She's done after this semester, but this class is great. It is interesting, and you will get a good grade if you try. I would def recommend it!
VERY passionate about the material and wants you to learn. Will hand out extra credit regularly and will help you through anything. 10/10 would recommend.

Very big grading curve but LOTS of homework and even with all that the quizzes are phrased in a odd and tricked form. Hours of reading and recordings to watch. Go to office hours if you want a good grade.

All material is posted online so you don't have to go to lecture. Only graded off weekly quizzes this semester but they were honorlocked. They were open note and easy enough if you watched the lectures. Grade thresholds got dropped by ~10% at the end of the semester so its an easy A

As long as you don't talk in class, be prepared to read and be patient, everything will be fine. Love her class, she will give you interesting examples about her and make the course content easy to understand. You can learn a lot from this class and some of the fact will surprise you. Again, love her and her class!
Very strict.

Extremely disorganized and very confusing concepts, also emails flooded with tons of information. You never feel like you can truly understand a lecture because she's going so fast, and also the quizzes are not on a singular topic, rather they skip back and forth. Also she punishes the entire class for academic integrity violations.

Great professor who cares about what you put into your body. Also a super interesting class to just have the knowledge for. The assignments take a lot of time but weren't painful to do. She allowed you to turn it in early to later on have it regraded after you made edits. Also super relatable professor!

Probably my favorite professor so far. Lots of extra credit, literally extra credit for showing up to class, but if you don't want to go she posts recordings of every single lecture. She is super knowledgeable and I learned so much from this class. Despite there being so much content so makes the exams super easy, curved the final a lot too.

One of the best classes you can take. I genuinely loved showing up to lectures every day and I learned so much. Dr. Wang is beyond knowledgeable in her field and makes every lecture super entertaining. You cannot ask for a better or more caring teacher than her.
Lots of extra credit. Do not talk during lectures. Study guides were very useful for revision.

A fine professor honestly. The class is easy enough to get a good grade in, but sometimes Wang drags on in her lectures. We ended the semester not learning about a good chunk of the concepts. Also the weekly quizzers were a bit tedious and annoying. She also refuses to post answers to quizzes even though the answers would be helpful for studying.

She does a great job of going in-depth with her lectures. Overall, the material is pretty easy and there is a lot of extra credit to raise your grade. She was very serious about talking in class and will stop lecture to call students out or drop them by a letter grade. But she gives great feedback and the material outside of class is manageable.
Good professor! You get extra credit for attending class! Very knowledgeable, would take again!

She is very passionate about her study. Her grading is very back and forth. 3 Assignments for the semester, an online quiz every week, and two exams. She is funny and lightens up her lectures. Was not my favorite or least favorite class from this semester.

Just DON'T talk in class and you will be just fine. If you talk prepare to lose your extra credit and be called out in class even if it is about material. Otherwise it is a great class as it is fun, interesting, and applicable. 2 Midterms both a lot like the study guide and a weekly online quiz which you can use notes. Lots of Xtra Credit.

Easy class as long as you complete weekly quizzes and submit assignment early for "early bird grading." This gives you a chance to correct any mistakes. There are two 30 question MC exams. If you know the study guide, then you will do fine. Do NOT talk during class, or you will lose extra credit or be dropped a letter grade.
Love her so engaging and makes it easy to understand hard material. You will do well if you put in the work!
do not talk in her class but she is so fun and hilarious.

She's nice, the class is relatively easy, and exams are a BREEZE if you complete her study guides. Grading is really hard and the weekly quizzes can be unnecessarily long and detailed. Her lectures are funny at times but she starting docking students letter grades for talking during lecture mid semester. Just be respectful and you'll be fine.

At first she seems like a really nice and approachable person, however, she is quite the opposite. She grades things very harshly for being in an online course and she is not accessible at all. Her rubrics are clear, but it seems as if she just makes up things as she grades. Also, she likes to make the class harder each semester if ppl do well.

I am currently taking her class online, however, experiences may differ in person. She is an extremely hard grader and takes points off for things that were never written in the rubric or assignment details. Also, she never provides good feedback on why you got the grade you did which makes it close to impossible to improve on future assignments.

Yirong is very knowledgeable and a great lecturer. The class is very easy and has only 1 hw assignment per month plus 3 exams. She literally gives you exam questions and answers during lecture, and the final was the easiest of all three. However, I found her hard to approach 1 on 1 and it seemed she favored those who participated in class.

Yirong is funny and really wants her students to succeed. She is just a little unorganized and unclear for some of the bio concepts. However, she gives you study guides that are exactly like the tests and plenty of extra credit opportunities. Final was insanely easy -- good choice if you just need a bio credit

Professor Wang is a nice person. She incorporated humor into her lectures and she genuinely cares about her students. Also the final exam was easy. However, I think she does a poor job explaining crucial concepts in the course and her English is not the greatest. Additionally the slides she uploads are hard to navigate and missing information.

Best professor for Nutri Sci. My only complaint would be that the lecture slides in class don't match the slides she uploads. However, she has entire recordings of her lecture so it's not too much of a problem. Course has very little homework. Prof uploads study guides for exams and offers a final project alternative to the exam so that's great

We haven't taken the exam yet, but someone has already stated their exam results in the spring of 2022. The professor's lecture is clear and easy to understand, but many people don't go to her lecture because they think it's easy. They lost their grades because of this, which made them angry and blamed the professor for making lectures too hard.

I did come into the semester thinking she was very funny and a kind woman. She did end up getting very frustrated with the class and took it out on everyone. Grading is very difficult and she changed the curriculum my semester, making it very hard on my class in comparison to her previous classes. Harder than you'd expect.

She is an amazing professor and works hard to give her students the tools for success and options to learn. Yes maybe some emotional emails were sent, but she is human. Being an older student, maybe I see the hard work she does and don't just expect A's to be handed out. I do notice a group of young students bullying her this semester

She gives out random 90% on tests if you answer a question correctly during lecture. She does not give much help at all just lecture and tests. Final project needed to be approved by her and she does not give enough time for students to go in and get it checked. Easy A class turned into a difficult class because of her.

She gives out guaranteed 90% and 85% on exams for people participating in pop-questions, all of which were on the fly and answered by people control f'ing on their google doc notes, for people with paper or written notes who cannot do this, or the hundreds of others who didn't get called on it's really demotivating.
Yirong wang is the funniest professor I have ever had. She doesn't even try to be funny she is just naturally hilarious
